outs.note: Williams remained out Wednesday against Atlanta, one of three injured Oklahoma City starters along with Cason Wallace and Chet Holmgren.
Holmgren remained out Wednesday against Atlanta. Isaiah Hartenstein grabbed 17 rebounds in his place.

Alex Caruso was moved from questionable to out for tonight (right hip soreness) on the NBA's 06:15 PM injury report. He had averaged 20 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
RJ Barrett was ruled out for 11/20 with a right hamstring strain after playing 39 minutes on 11/17. The show said he is expected to miss a couple of weeks.
Murray-Boyles entered the concussion protocol after Wednesday's loss to Washington and is out Friday at Detroit.
The show said Kawhi Leonard has been ruled out for about another week. No exact return date was given.
Allen is out Friday at Atlanta in the concussion protocol, his second straight missed game.
The show said Grant Williams is out for Charlotte on Friday, November 20. The show named Charlotte streaming options because of his absence, including Sion James in deeper leagues.
CJ McCollum is out for about a month, according to the show. Aaron Wiggins started in his place on Wednesday.
